summary: Installing automation dashboard, first steps: create an OAuth2 application (automation-dashboard-sso, authorization-code grant, confidential, redirect URI https://AUTOMATION_DASHBOARD_FQDN/auth-callback) at /access/applications on the gateway for AAP 2.5 and 2.6, create a read-scoped token, then copy inventory.example and set hosts and passwords.
questions: How do I set up OAuth for automation dashboard?
Where do I create an OAuth application in AAP 2.6?
What redirect URI does automation dashboard need?
How do I install automation dashboard?

answer_card.title: Prepare AAP for automation dashboard
answer_card.answer_md:
1. In AAP 2.5 or 2.6 go to `https://AAP_GATEWAY_FQDN/access/applications` and create an OAuth2 application: name `automation-dashboard-sso`, grant type `authorization-code`, organization `Default`, redirect URI `https://AUTOMATION_DASHBOARD_FQDN/auth-callback`, client type `Confidential`.
2. Put its `client_id` and `client_secret` in the dashboard inventory.
3. At `https://AAP_GATEWAY_FQDN/#/users/<id>/tokens` create a token for that application with scope `read`, and keep the access and refresh tokens for `clusters.yaml`.
4. `cp -i inventory.example inventory`, then set your FQDN and replace every `TODO` password.
